notes: RBox expansion paired with geography-replace-0010 (which makes 'has as its capital' the inverse of 'is the largest city of'): two made-up relations, tern_keeper_of (town to lake) and tern_kept_by (lake to town), are declared inverses, applied to real cities and lakes. The ties are made up, so what follows is fixed by the edit alone. Side facts are those of the revision record. Near unrelated asks the inverse property of the real pair 'contains' and 'borders' (reference no, as in the revision), so an edit that spreads inverseness to real relations is caught. Yes and no: direct and cross-lingual yes, the first instance asks whether the converse follows (yes), the second whether it could fail (no). The negation asks whether the two are not inverse (no).
